idea.title: Myth: AI video is too expensive
idea.angle: Compare it to the real cost: a camera crew, a reshoot, or a listing that sits for months. AI works from photos you already have, so there's no shoot day to pay for.
idea.hook: "AI VIDEO MUST BE EXPENSIVE." LET'S SEE.

slides.heading: PREMIUM VIDEO NEEDS A BIG BUDGET
A LISTING THAT **SITS**
slides.body: Weeks of posts nobody stops for. That costs more than any video.

slides.heading: ADS ON POSTS THAT **DON'T WORK**
slides.body: Boosting a weak post just shows a weak post to more people.

slides.heading: NO **SHOOT DAY** NEEDED
slides.body: AI works from the photos you already have. No crew, no reshoot.

slides.heading: ONE **RENTAL** COVERS IT
slides.body: One extra rental a month covers it. It pays for itself.

slides.heading: THE REAL QUESTION IS **VALUE**
slides.body: Not "what does it cost?" but "what does a quiet listing cost me?"

slides.heading: SEE WHAT YOUR PHOTOS CAN **DO**
slides.body: Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook

caption:
Premium video sounds like a big expense. Look at what you already pay for.

A listing that sits for weeks with no messages.
Ads on posts that don't stop the scroll.
A camera crew or a reshoot, if you film it the old way.
AI works from the photos you already have, so there's no shoot day at all.
One extra rental a month covers it.

What stops you from using video on every listing?

Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.
